question: Change the return type of the ParseAll() function in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/kio from ([]*yaml.RNode, error) to (RNodeList, error) where RNodeList is a new named type with different iteration semantics. ParseAll is the primary entry point for parsing multi-document YAML strings into RNode slices. Also change StringAll() from accepting []*yaml.RNode to accepting RNodeList. These functions are used by Helm for post-render manifest merging and splitting workflows.
